items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: Hans got up, he walked off.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Now he got that blind as a bat. See, make him shim, you see. That's what they done punch, Lee say. Lee say, punch coming in, she's going to go drunk. Boy come in there high as a kite. Well, Hines was playing at the Grand Terrace. Sure enough. Man, punch coming in. Him and Lee and Lewis, you know. They used to bum him. Yeah. Boy said, man, I'm going there and playing that fine bass. Lee say, man, don't go up there, punch. Man, who they talking about? Man, they ain't playing nothing. See, we…
Lee say, I told you, man, you can't play them people's range with some man.
